name: File Upload / Dropzone
summary: Native file input whose full-surface dropzone preserves browser selection, FileList, form, reset, and constraint-validation ownership while bounded enhancement reflects drag presence and announces selected file names.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Dropzone surface and file input positioning context.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native file input covering the dropzone.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the primary upload instruction when a file is required.

anatomy.name: hint
anatomy.description: Accepted format, size, or helper text.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Visible polite status initialized with the empty-state label and updated with native selected file names.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.description: Preview thumbnail for an uploaded or selected file.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Rejected or invalid file selection presentation.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: File selection that needs attention before submission.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator around the complete activation surface.

states.name: selected
states.description: Native FileList contains one or more selected files and visible status names them.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable native file control and dropzone surface.

states.name: requiredInvalid
states.description: Required native file control after constraint validation reports an empty FileList.

behavior.name: nativeFileInput
behavior.description: The sole native file input covers the dropzone and owns selection UI, FileList, submission, reset, accepted-file hints, capture hints, and validity.

behavior.name: dropzone
behavior.description: The shared enhancer only reflects drag presence. It does not prevent native drop, assign DataTransfer files, synthesize events, validate files, or create a second FileList owner.

behavior.name: selectedStatus
behavior.description: The shared enhancer derives visible status and selected class from the native FileList, listing authored file names without a locale-specific count template.

behavior.name: preview
behavior.description: Optional previews are target-owned derived content, remain synchronized with the native FileList, and include useful names or alt text; the base enhancer creates no object URLs.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible primary upload instruction and accessible name source.

properties.name: hint
properties.description: Visible accepted-format, size-policy, or upload guidance associated with the native input.

properties.name: emptyStatus
properties.description: Localized visible status used when the native FileList is empty and restored after form reset.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the selected files.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name used to identify submitted files.

properties.name: multiple
properties.description: Allows more than one native file selection.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires a non-empty native FileList and shows the standardized decorative marker beside the primary upload instruction.

properties.name: capture
properties.description: Optional native capture hint for user-facing or environment-facing media sources on supporting devices.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the native file input unavailable.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for accepted-file guidance or validation feedback.

accessibility: Use one native file input as the only FileList, form-value, reset, and constraint-validation owner.
Give the full visible dropzone one accessible name from its primary visible instruction.
Expose accepted file types and size limits in visible helper text.
Ensure drag-and-drop is an enhancement, not the only upload path.
Announce selected file names through a polite visible status and associate validation feedback without relying on color.
Do not claim that accept enforces policy; consuming targets validate type and size after selection.
Provide useful alt text or file names for target-owned image previews.
Do not create object URLs in the base enhancer; targets that preview local media own URL creation and revocation.

web.notes: Implemented by one full-surface native input, canonical CSS, and a bounded shared enhancer that reflects drag presence and FileList names. File validation, upload transport, and previews remain target-owned.
